name: PDF Catalog for WooCommerce + Drag And Drop Template Builder
author: add-ons.org

sections.description:
DEMO: https://demo.add-ons.org/woocommerce-pdf-catalog/product/beanie/
DOCUMENT: https://pdf.add-ons.org/document-pdf-catalog-for-woocommerce/
Pro Version: https://add-ons.org/plugin/pdf-catalog-for-woocommerce/

PDF Catalog Builder for WooCommerce is a powerful PDF catalog generator that helps you create professional PDF product catalogs directly from your WooCommerce store using a powerful drag-and-drop template builder.

Perfect for store owners, wholesalers, distributors, and B2B suppliers, the plugin allows customers and sales teams to generate branded product catalogs, brochures, line sheets, and price lists directly from your WooCommerce store.

Allow customers to download or receive PDF catalogs by email while automatically displaying real-time WooCommerce product data, including images, prices, SKUs, and descriptions.

Why Choose PDF Catalog Builder for WooCommerce?

  • Drag-and-drop catalog builder
  • No coding required
  • Real-time WooCommerce product data
  • Frontend PDF generation
  • Download or email PDF catalogs
  • Product categories and tag filtering
  • Custom branding and layouts
  • Multiple catalog templates
  • Multilingual and RTL ready
  • Product category and tag filtering

Key Features

  • Visual Drag & Drop Template Builder: Absolutely no coding required. Use the intuitive visual editor to drag elements like product images, titles, pricing, and custom text into your preferred layout.
  • Generate PDF on WooCommerce Frontend: Seamlessly integrates with your store’s frontend. Add download buttons on Single Product Pages, Shop Pages, and Category Pages, saving time for both you and your customers.
  • Dynamic Product Data Retrieval: The PDF pulls real-time information from your WooCommerce database, ensuring that prices, stock status, descriptions, and galleries are always accurate and up-to-date.
  • Custom Shortcode Support ([yeekit_pdf_catalog]): Highly flexible! Place a catalog download button ANYWHERE on your site (Elementor widgets, blog posts, static pages) using our built-in shortcode.
  • Download or Email Instantly: Provide flexibility by allowing users to either download the PDF document directly to their device or receive it via email. Perfect for B2B quoting and lead generation.
  • Fully Customizable Design & Branding: Take full control of the appearance. Add your company logo, custom headers, footers, typography, spacing, and brand colors to ensure a professional look.
  • Multilingual & RTL Ready: Fully compatible with translation plugins like WPML and Polylang, and completely supports Right-to-Left (RTL) languages.
  • Developer Friendly & Optimized: Lightweight, fast, and optimized for performance so it won’t slow down your store. Includes hooks and filters for advanced customizations.

Popular Use Cases

Product Catalogs

Create downloadable product catalogs for customers and sales teams.

Wholesale Catalogs

Generate printable wholesale catalogs with product pricing and details.

Product Brochures

Create branded PDF brochures for marketing and sales presentations.

Line Sheets

Generate professional product line sheets for distributors and retailers.

Price Lists

Create up-to-date PDF price lists directly from WooCommerce data.

Product Presentations

Share professional product showcases with customers and business partners.

How to use the Shortcode

You can place a PDF catalog download button anywhere on your WordPress site using the following shortcode:

[yeekit_pdf_catalog id="YOUR_TEMPLATE_ID" label="Download Catalog" name="my-awesome-catalog"]

Shortcode Attributes:
* id (Required): The ID of your PDF Template (You can find this by looking at the Post ID of your template in the PDF Catalog Builder menu).
* label (Optional): The text displayed on the button. Default: “Download Catalog”.
* name (Optional): The file name of the PDF when downloaded. Default: “catalog”.

Example: If your template ID is 104, using [yeekit_pdf_catalog id="104" label="Get Product Brochure" name="brochure-2024"] will display a button that says “Get Product Brochure” and downloads the file as brochure-2024.pdf.

Upgrade to Pro

Unlock advanced catalog customization and automation features:

  • Advanced Catalog Layouts
  • Custom Headers & Footers
  • Multiple Catalog Templates
  • Email Catalog Delivery
  • Product Category & Tag Filters
  • Custom Branding & Watermarks
  • Priority Support
sections.installation:
Normal installation

  1. Download the plugin .zip file to your computer.
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress dashboard.
  3. Click Upload Plugin and select the .zip file you downloaded.
  4. Click Install Now and activate the plugin after installation.
  5. Create your first template in the PDF Catalog menu!
sections.faq:
Can customers generate catalogs from the frontend?

Yes. Customers can generate PDF catalogs directly from the frontend without accessing the WordPress dashboard.

Can I include WooCommerce product images and prices?

Yes. Product images, prices, SKUs, descriptions, and other WooCommerce data can be displayed in the PDF catalog.

Can users download or receive catalogs by email?

Yes. Users can download PDF catalogs instantly or receive them by email.

Can I create multiple catalog templates?

Yes. You can create and reuse multiple catalog templates for different purposes.

Can I generate catalogs from product categories?

Yes. You can generate PDF catalogs for individual products, product categories, or filtered product collections.

Does it work with variable products?

Yes. The plugin supports WooCommerce simple and variable products.

Can I customize the PDF layout?

Yes. The drag-and-drop builder allows you to fully customize the catalog design without coding.
